title: Texans will need to re-do contracts for Danielle Hunter, Dalton Schultz after NFL ruling

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Texans will need to re-do contracts for Danielle Hunter, Dalton Schultz after NFL ruling
sources.description: The Texans agreed to one-year contracts with pass rusher Danielle Hunter and tight end Dalton Schultz before the start of free agency, but contracts aren't official in the NFL until the league office has approved them.
